annotations.text:
Revised against the Final Consolidated Handoff.

Section order per §21. Orange accent replaced with the Price2Book system: blue/navy for product, pricing, scheduling and control; green reserved for While We're There™, availability and positive states.

Warm editorial character kept as instructed — the paper and typography are unchanged.

Accuracy per the handoff:

• Integration badges are truthful. Jobber is genuinely built (OAuth, push, crew sync, live availability) = Available. ServiceTitan / Housecall Pro / Google Calendar have no code = Coming Soon. Our scheduler = Built In.

• "Price2Book can suggest. You approve." replaces the old line about the rate re-deriving prices — that contradicted §13.

• Service counts replaced with "dozens".

• No invented testimonials; the proof section names the metrics to fill once pilots exist.
